learning.title: Separate Paper token dimensions from raster dependencies
learning.trigger: Published JSX and PNG exports disagree after binding captured theme values.
learning.mistake: Converted text, spacing and radius values to CSS lengths but left container widths unitless. CSS accepted the custom property but rejected its use as a width, causing intrinsic flex widths and extra wrapping.
learning.rule: Bind every admitted length-token family, including container widths, with its CSS unit; keep font weights unitless. Inspect computed widths, text rectangles and actual platform fonts before changing layout or blaming font files. Matching family names does not pin generic-font fallback, hinting or fractional PNG raster origin. Unknown producer identity alone does not prohibit a deterministic renderer configuration. Pin supported configuration in both production source and candidate paths, scoped by profile and bound into compatibility metadata; preserve every failed full-frame comparison. Never infer an export offset from target pixels.
learning.capture-context: Playwright page screenshot clips without fullPage are viewport-relative: adding document scroll can truncate a complete target and misreport its first-row paint. Compare PNG dimensions before interpreting edge RGBA. An opaque intermediate ancestor defeats BODY-only canvas backing; validate and reversibly back the immediate target canvas, preserving descendants and exact control equality. Chromium 153.0.8010.12 with Playwright 1.63.0 fullPage capture beyond the viewport was observed to disable touch emulation during capture: maxTouchPoints 1 becomes 0, pointer coarse becomes fine, and pointer-responsive pixels change. Restoring touch after that capture does not repair the already incorrect PNG. Verify input media as well as geometry before and after full-UI capture; never waive the context assertion. On that same browser/toolchain, page.screenshot with clip and no fullPage clamps the requested clip to the viewport: a 100×142 request at viewport 100×101 returns only 100×101, despite preserving pointer media. body locator screenshot returns the complete 100×142 but also loses touch/coarse media and paints fine-pointer pixels throughout, including below the fold. Neither native option is a faithful coarse-pointer full-content replacement. DOM and natural-height equality alone cannot prove capture fidelity; assert complete PNG dimensions and below-fold pointer-responsive pixels too.

verification.requirement: Container declarations carry px; weights remain unitless; K-0 originals stay byte-identical; the V-0 identity changes only in a reviewed refresh commit through `render:paper:v0`, which re-pins its digest in `paper-source-profiles.node.mjs` and `paper-whole-artboard.node.mjs`. With K0_RENDER_OUTPUT set, exact frame heights and the unchanged 0.95 full-frame threshold remain enforced.
